name: Intercom
description: Search Intercom conversations and contacts, and read a thread in full.
long_description:
Intercom's own hosted server. It searches conversations and contacts, reads a thread with its notes, and — when you let it — replies.

You sign in through Intercom in your browser. A reply is a message a customer reads, so it is confirmed every time, whatever the chat's mode.

auth.instructions: Sign in to Intercom in your browser; the server registers Gantry on the spot.

risk.notes: Reaches your Intercom inbox and contacts. A reply is read by a customer, so it is always confirmed.
